independence: Literal expected records typed from separate source inspection; not produced by the examples worker adapter. Direct-source observation only, not a managed receipt.

extractors.selected_variant: $.hasVariant[?(@.sku == selected_sku)] exactly one per selected sku
extractors.sku: selected.sku (string; do not infer a distinct variant_id)
extractors.pack: exact ^(3|16)oz$ size mapping to integer weight ounces, no sample or teabag count inference
extractors.price: selected.offers.price as Decimal from literal JSON number/string; exactly two decimal output; never use $.offers.lowPrice
extractors.availability: selected.offers.availability explicit schema.org literal; missing/unrecognized -> unknown
extractors.offer_url: selected.offers.url equals single selected source URL
extractors.shipping_label: page DOM [itemprop="shippingLabel"][content="Standard Ground"] (context only; not selectedfulfilment)
dom_corrobation: #itemBlock_001036002 .size =3oz with85gr secondarylabel; classOutOfStock and textout ofstock
#itemBlock_001036004 .size =16oz with454gr secondarylabel; classOutOfStock and textout ofstock

structural_limits: No hasVariant product isVariantOf property; group membership comes from containment.
Shared offer/source URL; identify selected records by group+SKU+size.
Posted listed-variant offer basis, not asserted one_time or subscription price.
Page US shipping context, not a proxy-country guarantee or selectedcheckoutdestination.
Fulfilment unselected; OutOfStock not treated as unknown or orderable.
DOM_corroboration_scope: Gram secondary labels are the earlier direct-capture context only; managed capture showed size/OutOfStock labels without those gram labels.
